title: After the Queen Elizabeth II Cup: It's Decided!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho runs a fantastic race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Judging from her performance today and how hard she fought in the Triple Tiara races, I'd be surprised if anyone doubted her credentials as a representative of the Tiara winners.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo! Sweep! Sweep! Sweep! Sweeeep!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Show us your magic! Show us that strength is strength! Prove it in your senior-year races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She smiles confidently amidst the roaring cheers, and I realize I have the answer! The perfect race for her to realize everything she's worked for is…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You've made up your mind, right? Good. Let me hear it!
choice_data_list: Right. Our next race goal is…
Right. Our next race goal is…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The race I suggest has to be the best possible stage—a spring race in which only chosen Umamusume are permitted to compete.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And not only that, but a grueling event that no Umamusume on the Triple Tiara tour has managed to win in decades.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that's where she's going to cast her magic on the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that's where she's going to cast her magic on the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hah! The Takarazuka Kinen, huh? I like it. You pass.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Buuuut!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Too baaad! ♪ I can't give you a gold star for that answer!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I mean, I don't think the Takarazuka Kinen is a bad race to shoot for. It's just not enough on its own.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: If I'm gonna use a grand magic spell to change the world, that one race isn't gonna cut it. I've gotta do something even more special.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You get where this is going, right, Familiar?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna run in the Yasuda Kinen, too!
choice_data_list: The Yasuda Kinen and then the Takarazuka Kinen too?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is held in the first half of June, and the Takarazuka Kinen in the second half.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Competing in the Takarazuka Kinen alone is going to make for a formidable challenge, and there's just not enough time between races!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I try explaining that most racers would never normally attempt both, but she stops me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You should already know this, but normal's not gonna fly!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna pull off my grand magic spell at the most ultra special race of all!
